proposed_induced: Warns that initiating or changing any anxiety medication or supplement while on warfarin requires physician supervision due to bleeding risk and potential INR fluctuations.
Advises against self-prescribing or using over-the-counter remedies for anxiety without medical clearance, given warfarin’s narrow therapeutic index and high interaction potential.
Clarifies that while photobiomodulation itself has no known warfarin interaction, any concurrent pharmacological anxiety management must be coordinated with anticoagulation monitoring.
